channel.description: Newest perfume decant arrivals at Decantified

item.title: Mortal by Caneza – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Caneza
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 54.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Mortal is a bold, fruity woody Eau de Parfum for men and women. Bright grapefruit and juicy pineapple burst open over a heart of earthy patchouli, jasmine and cedar. It settles on a mossy, warm base of oakmoss and amber, a confident scent often compared to Creed Aventus.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Grapefruit, Pineapple
Middle: Patchouli, Jasmine, Cedar
Base: Oakmoss, Amber

Best for

Season: Spring, fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection

item.title: Mezmar Women by Caneza – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Caneza
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 49.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Mezmar Women is a warm white-floral gourmand Eau de Parfum from Caneza with a quietly magnetic trail. Roasted coffee and sweet almond open into a heart of tuberose and jasmine softened by tonka, drying down to vanilla, sandalwood and cocoa, often compared to Carolina Herrera Good Girl.

Sweet, sensual and confident, it is made for evenings out and date nights in the cooler months.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Almond, Coffee
Middle: Tuberose, Jasmine, Tonka Bean
Base: Cocoa, Sandalwood, Vanilla

Best for

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: date night, night out · Time: night

item.title: Uomo by Caneza – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Caneza
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 54.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Uomo is a fresh, fruity-aromatic Eau de Parfum for men. Crisp lemon, bergamot and green apple open with a pinch of nutmeg, before a marine heart of plum, orange blossom and davana. It dries down to a smooth, easygoing base of amber, musk and patchouli that suits everyday wear.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lemon, Apple, Nutmeg, Bergamot
Middle: Marine Notes, Plum, Orange Blossom, Davana
Base: Amber, Musk, Patchouli

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday · Performance: moderate projection

item.title: Forest Grove by Caneza – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Caneza
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 54.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Forest Grove is a green, aromatic-woody unisex Eau de Parfum from Caneza, launched in 2026. Sharp galbanum, ginger and a burst of bitter orange, grapefruit and bergamot open onto a soft heart of matcha, sunny florals and fig, drying down to clean sandalwood, cedarwood, dry amber and musk.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bitter Orange, Grapefruit, Bergamot, Galbanum, Ginger
Middle: Floral Notes, Mahonial, Petalia, Fig
Base: Sandalwood, Sylkolide, Cedarwood, Amber, Musk

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday · Time: daytime

item.title: Mezmar Men by Caneza – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Caneza
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 49.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Mezmar Men is a fresh woody-aromatic Eau de Parfum from Caneza with quiet strength and easy charm. Bright bergamot, lavender and cardamom open into a clean orange blossom and geranium heart over a grounded base of patchouli and musk, often compared to Yves Saint Laurent MYSLF Eau de Parfum.

Polished and versatile, it is a modern masculine scent that works from the office to a dinner out.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Lavender, Cardamom
Middle: Orange Blossom, Geranium, Oakmoss
Base: Patchouli, Musk

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, date night · Time: day or night

item.title: Mezmar Café Vanilla by Caneza – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Caneza
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 49.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Mezmar Café Vanilla is a sweet, comforting vanilla gourmand from Caneza's Mezmar line, an Eau de Parfum for women. Buttery caramel and cream open with a hint of liquorice, melting into a honeyed heart of jasmine and tonka before settling on soft vanilla and musk. It is a creamy, dessert-like vanilla often compared to Giardini di Toscana Bianco Latte.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Caramel, Cream
Middle: Honey, Jasmine, Tonka
Base: Vanilla, Musk

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, cosy evenings · Time: evening

item.title: Prisca by Caneza – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Caneza
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 54.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Prisca is a creamy white floral for women, an Eau de Parfum that opens with juicy peach and mandarin wrapped around a lush tuberose. Gardenia, jasmine and a powdery touch of orris build a soft, radiant heart, settling into a smooth base of vanilla, sandalwood and vetiver. It is often compared to Nishane Hundred Silent Ways.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Tuberose, Peach, Mandarin
Middle: Gardenia, Jasmine, Orris
Base: Vanilla, Sandalwood, Vetiver

Best for

Season: Spring and fall · Wear it: date night, special occasions · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Elara by Caneza – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Caneza
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 54.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Elara is a luminous fruity-floral Eau de Parfum from Caneza, opening on juicy lychee, pear and bergamot with a soft, creamy pistachio edge. A rose-and-incense heart gives it a gentle glow before it settles into warm amber, vanilla and musk, often compared to Parfums de Marly Delina Exclusif.

Sweet, airy and quietly elegant, it is a polished feminine scent for evenings and special moments that stays bright enough for daytime.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Lychee, Pear, Pistachio
Middle: Rose, Incense
Base: Musk, Amber, Vanilla

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: date night, special occasion · Time: day or night

item.title: Mezmar Mocha Blend by Caneza – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Caneza
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 49.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Mezmar Mocha Blend is a coffeehouse gourmand from Caneza's Mezmar line, an Eau de Parfum for men. Bright grapefruit and a thread of olibanum open onto a creamy roasted coffee-and-mocha heart, drying down to sweet vanilla over cedar. It is a warm, sweet coffee scent often compared to Emporio Armani Stronger With You Intensely.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Olibanum, Grapefruit
Middle: Coffee, Mocha, Cream
Base: Vanilla, Cedar

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Time: evening

item.title: Hero Parfum Intense by Burberry – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Burberry
Type:
Price: 4.49 - 29.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Hero Parfum Intense is the darkest, most concentrated take on Burberry's Hero line: a dry, smoky leather built over a cedarwood core and lit up with cracked black pepper. It reads warm, gritty and grown-up, with a subtle amber sweetness in the dry-down. Released in 2025, it is bottled at Parfum strength, the house's richest concentration (Extrait de Parfum level).

Fragrance Notes

Top: Black Pepper
Middle: Leather
Base: Cedarwood

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Polo Red Parfum by Ralph Lauren – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Ralph Lauren
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Polo Red Parfum is the richest version of Ralph Lauren's Polo Red line: a bright, spicy citrus opening of blood orange, bergamot and pink pepper that settles into an aromatic heart of absinthe, lavender and orris over warm cedar, musk and opoponax. It is a Parfum, the most concentrated Polo Red, hand-decanted from the original bottle into a 1ml sample or a 4ml, 5ml or 10ml travel spray.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Blood Orange, Bergamot, Pink Pepper
Middle: Absinthe, Lavender, Orris
Base: Musk, Cedar, Opoponax

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, date night, everyday · Time: day and night

item.title: Tharwah Gold by Lattafa – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Lattafa
Type: Fragrance Decant
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (6 variants)

Overview

Tharwah Gold is a golden, candied floral from Lattafa's Pride line: a bright lavender-and-bergamot opening melts into orange blossom and jasmine, then dries down to warm vanilla and amber. It is an Eau de Parfum, sweet but polished, often compared to Yves Saint Laurent Libre Intense.

The lavender keeps the sweetness lifted, while the vanilla-amber base gives it a cosy, glowing trail that suits cooler evenings.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lavender, Bergamot
Middle: Orange Blossom, Egyptian Jasmine
Base: Vanilla, Amber, Vetiver

Best for

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: date night, special occasions · Time: evening

item.title: Phantom Intense by Rabanne – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Rabanne
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Phantom Intense by Rabanne is a bolder, warmer face of the Phantom line, an Eau de Parfum Intense built on an aromatic-amber accord of lavender, vanilla bean and frosted orange blossom. It opens bright with lemon and cardamom, settles into lavender, clary sage and a touch of rum, then dries down to creamy vanilla over moss and cedarwood. Hand-decanted from the original Rabanne bottle into a 1ml sample, 4ml, 5ml or 10ml travel spray.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Frosted Orange Blossom, Lemon, Cardamom
Middle: Lavender, Clary Sage, Rum
Base: Vanilla Bean, Moss, Cedarwood

Best for

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: date night, nights out, office · Performance: moderate to strong, an Eau de Parfum Intense

item.description:

Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (6 variants)

Overview

Al Barari Shore is a sweet, fruity leather scent for men from Zimaya, released in 2025 and often compared to Azzaro Forever Wanted Elixir. This Eau de Parfum opens on raspberry, mandarin and bergamot, warms through lavender, cardamom and musk, and settles into a smooth base of leather, vanilla, vetiver and sage.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Raspberry, Mandarin Orange, Bergamot
Middle: Lavender, Cardamom, Musk
Base: Leather, Vanilla, Vetiver, Sage

Best for

Season: Fall and winter · Wear it: date night, nights out · Vibe: crowd-pleaser

item.title: Checkmate Black Knight by Armaf – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Armaf
Type:
Price: 1.99 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

Checkmate Black Knight is a bright, woody-aromatic men's scent from Armaf's 2026 Checkmate line, and many wearers find it often compared to Creed Aventus. This Eau de Parfum opens with juicy orange, bergamot and cardamom over a thread of incense, moves through cool eucalyptus, lavender and rose, and dries down to vanilla, ambrox, patchouli and guaiac wood.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Orange, Cardamom, Bergamot, Olibanum, Incense, Pink Pepper
Middle: Eucalyptus, Lavender, Rose
Base: Vanilla, Ambrox, Patchouli, Guaiac Wood, Cypriol

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, date night · Vibe: crowd-pleaser

item.description:
Vendor: Arabiyat Prestige
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 20.00 (5 variants)

Overview

La Di Da For Her is a sweet floral-fruity gourmand from Arabiyat Prestige, released in 2025 as the partner to La Di Da For Him. This Eau de Parfum opens on juicy raspberry and a squeeze of lemon, blooms into creamy tuberose, ylang-ylang and rose, and settles on a warm, powdery base of vanilla, benzoin and musk.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sweet Notes, Raspberry, Lemon
Middle: Tuberose, Ylang-Ylang, Rose
Base: Vanilla, Benzoin, Musk

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: date night, nights out · Vibe: sweet and playful

item.title: Thunder by French Avenue – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: French Avenue
Type:
Price: 2.45 - 22.16 (6 variants)

Overview

Thunder is a creamy, powdery woody-aromatic Eau de Parfum from French Avenue. Lavender, bergamot and pink pepper open bright and lightly spicy before a soft heart of iris, vanilla milk and geranium settles onto tonka, cedar and vetiver. It is a polished, elegant iris scent often compared to Penhaligon's The Omniscient Mister Thompson.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lavender, Bergamot, Elemi, Pink Pepper
Middle: Iris, Vanilla, Milk, Geranium
Base: Tonka Bean, Cedarwood, Vetiver

Best for

Season: Fall, winter and spring · Wear it: office, date night · Performance: lasts well, wears closer than it lasts

item.title: Fleur de Paris by Ainash Parfums – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Ainash Parfums
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 21.09 (6 variants)

Overview

Fleur de Paris by Ainash Parfums is a bright, elegant white-floral musk, an Extrait de Parfum from the Miami-born house. It opens like a Paris morning with sparkling bergamot, mandarin and juicy white peach, blooms into a soft heart of white flowers, and dries down to a clean, long-lasting trail of musk and ambroxan.

Fresh, feminine and polished, it is often compared to Parfums de Marly Valaya.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Mandarin, White Peach
Heart: White Flowers
Base: Musk, Ambroxan

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, date night · Performance: long-lasting

item.title: Erba Pura by Xerjoff – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Xerjoff
Type:
Price: 5.99 - 44.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Erba Pura is Xerjoff's famous fruity-musky niche scent, an Eau de Parfum by perfumers Christian Carbonnel and Laura Santander. It bursts open with juicy Sicilian orange, Calabrian bergamot and lemon over a basket of sweet fruits, then settles into a soft, creamy trail of white musk, Madagascar vanilla and amber.

Loud, radiant and instantly likeable, it is one of the best-known compliment-getters in niche perfumery, with the projection and staying power the house is known for.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sicilian Orange, Calabrian Bergamot, Sicilian Lemon
Middle: Fruits
Base: White Musk, Madagascar Vanilla, Amber

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: date night, nights out · Performance: long-lasting, strong projection

item.title: Cloud 9 by Gulf Orchid – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Gulf Orchid
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 39.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Cloud 9 by Gulf Orchid is a soft, airy floral woody musk, an Eau de Parfum for women and men often compared to Carolina Herrera Cedar Chic. Sparkling aldehydes and bergamot open clean and bright, orange blossom and lily of the valley give it a delicate white-floral heart, and it dries down to a smooth, soapy-clean base of musk and cedarwood. Not to be confused with Armaf's Cloud 9, a different fragrance.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Aldehydes, Bergamot
Middle: Orange Blossom, Lily of the Valley
Base: Musk, Cedarwood

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, everyday, daytime

item.title: Kenzo Homme Indigo by Kenzo – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Kenzo
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Kenzo Homme Indigo is a cool, powdery marine-leather scent from Kenzo, an Eau de Parfum composed by perfumer Quentin Bisch and named after Japan's indigo-dyeing tradition. A breezy aquatic opening drifts into soft, powdery iris, then dries down to a smoky, woody leather accord with sandalwood and akigalawood.

It takes the fresh Kenzo Homme DNA somewhere darker and more refined: still clean and airy up top, but with a suede-like depth that carries from day into evening.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sea Notes
Middle: Iris
Base: Leather, Sandalwood, Akigalawood

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, date night · Performance: moderate, polished day-to-night wear

item.title: Dubai London by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Maison Asrar
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (6 variants)

Overview

Dubai London is a woody aromatic from Maison Asrar's Dubai city collection, an Eau de Parfum for women and men in a globe-shaped bottle. Lavender, pink pepper and citrus give it a fresh, spicy lift, a heart of orris, apricot and hazelnut adds a soft, nutty warmth, and cedar, cashmeran, vetiver and musk settle it into a smooth, refined woody drydown.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Lavender, Pink Pepper, Citrus
Middle: Orris, Apricot, Hazelnut
Base: Cedar, Cashmeran, Musk, Vetiver

Best for

Season: Spring, fall and winter · Wear it: office, date night, day or evening

item.title: Kenzo Homme Marine by Kenzo – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Kenzo
Type:
Price: 3.99 - 26.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Kenzo Homme Marine is a salty, sun-warmed marine scent from Kenzo, an Eau de Toilette composed by perfumer Quentin Bisch. Bright sea notes open over a creamy, slightly sweet ylang-ylang heart, then settle into smooth sandalwood and soft musk for a clean, skin-like seaside trail.

It sits in the woody-aquatic lane of the Kenzo Homme line: fresh and easy to wear, with more warmth and softness than a typical blue fragrance.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Sea Notes
Middle: Ylang-Ylang
Base: Sandalwood, Musk

Best for

Season: Spring and summer · Wear it: office, gym, everyday · Performance: moderate, fresh daytime wear

item.title: Midnight Frost Eclipse by Anfar London – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Anfar London
Type:
Price: 2.25 - 44.99 (6 variants)

Overview

Midnight Frost Eclipse by Anfar London is the warmest and sweetest of the Midnight Frost line, an Extrait de Parfum with a modern aquatic-woody character. It opens on mineral amber, grapefruit, bergamot, apple and melon, moves through a breezy heart of cypress, lavender, coconut, pear and sea salt, and dries down soft and cosy on vanilla, tonka, benzoin and cedarwood. Fresh enough for the day and smooth enough for the evening, it is one of the most versatile in the line.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Mineral Amber, Italian Bergamot, Grapefruit, Apple, Melon
Middle: Cypress, Lavender, Coconut, Pear, Sea Salt
Base: Cedarwood, Vanilla, Benzoin, Ambrofix, Tonka Bean

Best for

Season: Year-round, best in spring and fall · Wear it: date night, office, everyday · Time: day and night

item.title: Dubai Milano by Maison Asrar – Sample Decant
item.description:
Vendor: Maison Asrar
Type:
Price: 2.49 - 22.50 (6 variants)

Overview

Dubai Milano is a fruity leather scent from Maison Asrar's Dubai city collection, an Eau de Parfum for women and men in a globe-shaped bottle. Bergamot, pineapple, mango and guava open bright and juicy over a silky accord, smooth leather with cypress and violet leaf gives the heart a polished Italian edge, and vanilla, musk and labdanum finish it warm and softly ambery.

Fragrance Notes

Top: Bergamot, Pineapple, Mango, Guava, Silk Accord
Middle: Cypress, Leather, Violet Leaf
Base: Vanilla, Musk, Labdanum

Best for

Season: Spring, summer and fall · Wear it: office, date night, day or evening
